item.title: Australia’s social media ban has taken effect, and the world is watching
item.description: On December 10, Australia became the first nation in the world to ban teenagers from major social media apps. The federal restriction prevents citizens under the age of 16 from accessing YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X, Snapchat, Reddit, Twitch, and Kick.
